body:
Runner custody lessons and Windows B cleanup constraint from Fable2 #4222/#4223/#4235 (Nov4), not a current queue or availability census. A queued job is not moved from one runner by silence: withdraw the original exact request and receive the answer before placing another; a withdrawal can cross START. A runner inside a FULL may be unable to read mail, so delayed wakes do not establish lost delivery. Use the current session listing and coordinator's named GO for actual runner identity and availability; historic session5 approval status and first-job results remain only in revisions1–3.

Windows B cleanup remains subject to Engram::Fable's owner release under w-789a7d0e554d: no general cleanup wording lifts that host's ban. Every actual path needs the current named release and ownership/path checks. The old Nov4 allowlist was for those exact windows only and is retained in revision3, not new deletion authority. In particular t/j/441d17a7 and n3f were expressly retained until their named release; this consolidation neither declares that release nor touches them. No queued job, source tree, runtime or artifact is changed.
